description: This file declares the ControlClientServerInternal class, which implements the IControlClientServerInternal interface for IPC control within the Rialto server component. It includes method declarations for notifying application state and pinging, and manages internal control ID and IPC client references.

classes.name: ControlClientServerInternal
classes.description: Implements IPC control client-server internal logic, managing control ID and IPC client communication.

methods.name: ControlClientServerInternal
methods.description: Constructor initializing control ID and IPC client reference.

methods.name: notifyApplicationState
methods.description: Notifies the application of a new application state.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message with the specified ID.
